# Regionshospitalet Silkeborg

Regionshospitalet Silkeborg is a hospital that forms part of Hospitalsenhed Midt, one of the regional hospital units in Denmark's health system[^src1][^src2]. It appears in the corpus as the workplace of [[lars-frost|Lars Frost]], overlæge (senior consultant) and dr.med., who serves as chairman (formand) of the steering group behind the AFDK annual report[^src1]. The hospital's inclusion in the 2023 annual report of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) is limited to this affiliation: it is named as the institutional home of the report's steering-group chairman, situating it within the national quality-registry infrastructure coordinated by RKKP (Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram)[^src1][^src2].

The AFDK 2023 report, which covers the period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023 and analyzes treatment quality for 19,671 incident and 134,810 prevalent atrial fibrillation patients across Danish public hospitals, credits its steering group — led by Lars Frost — with producing the report's conclusions and recommendations on indicators such as anticoagulation therapy, echocardiography, TSH measurement, bleeding risk, and patient education. Regionshospitalet Silkeborg's role in this broader narrative is thus indirect: it is documented in the corpus solely as the clinical institution employing the report's chairman, rather than as a subject of clinical performance data itself.

No further details about the hospital's own operations, patient volumes, or performance metrics are present in the available data.
